select s.*, i.thumb_url, i.image_name as image_code, c.group_name, c.gender, c.species, c.product_series from tb_slide s left join tb_image i on s.image_id = i.image_id left join tb_image_csv c on c.id = s.image_csv_id
AND s.project_id = #{params.projectId}
AND s.create_by = #{params.userId}
AND i.image_code like CONCAT('%',#{params.imageCode},'%')
AND s.remark like CONCAT('%',#{params.remark},'%')
AND s.status = #{params.status}
AND EXISTS(select u.slide_id from tb_slide_attr u where u.slide_id = s.slide_id and u.attr_type = '1' and u.attr_id = #{params.annoUser})
AND EXISTS(select c.slide_id from tb_slide_attr c where c.slide_id = s.slide_id and c.attr_type = '2' and c.attr_id = #{params.annoCategory})
and date_format(s.create_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.createTimeParams.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.create_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.createTimeParams.endTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.update_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.updateTimeParams.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(s.update_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.updateTimeParams.endTime},'%y%m%d')

select m.*, s.slide_id, s.diagnosis, s.ai_analyzed, s.ai_check, r.score, csv.id, csv.image_id, csv.image_name, csv.group_name, csv.gender, csv.species, csv.product_series, csv.dosage, csv.animal_source, csv.receiving_week, csv.dosing_cycle, csv.recovery_cycle, csv.date_of_death, csv.remove_reason, csv.remark, csv.organ, csv.lesion_type1, csv.lesion_degree1, csv.lesion_type2, csv.lesion_degree2, csv.process_flag, csv.create_by, csv.create_time, csv.update_by, csv.update_time, csv.topic_id, csv.topic_name, csv.status, csv.delete_flag, csv.organization_id, csv.host_id from tb_slide s left join tb_image m on m.image_id = s.image_id left join tb_image_csv csv on csv.id = s.image_csv_id left join (select slide_id, group_concat(score separator '-') as score from tb_review t group by t.slide_id) r on s.slide_id = r.slide_id
AND csv.image_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.imageCode},'%')
AND s.project_id = #{params.projectId}
AND r.score like CONCAT('%',#{params.score},'%')
AND csv.remove_reason like CONCAT('%',#{params.removeReason},'%')
AND r.slide_id is null
AND r.slide_id is not null
AND r.slide_id is null
AND r.slide_id is not null
